Answer: D
Reason: Figure 1 shows dense consolidation in the left lung, while Figure 2 demonstrates a decrease in this original opacity alongside the appearance of new consolidations in the right upper lobe and left lower zone. This shifting or "migratory" pattern of pulmonary opacities is a hallmark radiographic feature of cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP).
